content:
A pickup truck caught fire near a home in the 3004 block of E. Gustavus Street in east Laredo on Friday, November 6, sending heavy smoke into the air and drawing emergency responders to the scene.

Flames from the burning truck spread to a nearby tree, according to reports from the scene. The truck was burning dangerously close to the residence, and the extent of any damage to the home was not immediately known.

No injuries have been confirmed at this time. Residents and drivers in the area were urged to use caution and keep the area clear so emergency crews could work.

Sources: Hammrod News Laredo TX; KGNS Telenoticias+ / Telemundo Laredo.
